en: When Congress passes a bill and the President signs it, the proposed legislation officially becomes a binding national law.
If the Supreme Court finds a new law violates the Constitution, the justices declare it unconstitutional and completely void.
The Ifugao muyong forest system captures rainwater, which slowly drains down to irrigate the stone-walled rice terraces below.
Andres Bonifacio recruited Katipunan members by having them sign admission papers with their own blood to ensure absolute secrecy.
The Philippine eagle uses its specialized, strongly curved beak to tear apart prey, allowing it to survive in the forest canopy.
Weavers extract strong fibers from abaca plant stalks to weave durable traditional textiles like the native sinamay fabric.
When Filipino citizens cast their ballots during national elections, their votes determine who wins the executive and legislative seats.
Jose Rizal wrote his novels to expose Spanish colonial abuses, which awakened Filipino nationalism and inspired the revolution.
Artisans cover bamboo frames with translucent capiz shells, allowing light from inside to shine through as a traditional Christmas parol.
When neighbors have a dispute, the barangay captain mediates the conflict to reach a peaceful settlement without going to court.
The mambabatok taps soot and water into the skin using a thorn, causing the body to heal with permanent traditional batok tattoos.
When the government collects taxes from citizens, it uses that revenue to fund public schools, hospitals, and roads.
